content.title: <RichColor Color="1,0.851,0,1">BAWBAGS OF ARK | PVE</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.94,0.96,0.92,1">Your next adventure starts here.

Build a home, raise your favourite creatures and explore our PvE cluster with other survivors.

XP 2x  |  Harvesting 3x  |  Taming 5x
Maturation 10x

Earn tokens as you play and spend them in the Reward Shop.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="1,0.851,0,1">YOUR SURVIVOR GUIDE</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.94,0.96,0.92,1">TOKENS
See how playtime earns currency for the shop.

REWARD SHOP
Browse dinosaurs, check prices and learn about delivery.

SERVER SETTINGS
View our progression and breeding rates.

COMMUNITY
Find our maps, Discord and help information.

Press F1 to return to this guide.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="1,0.851,0,1">PLAY. EARN. SPEND.</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.94,0.96,0.92,1">Tokens are the currency used in the Bawbags Reward Shop.

Earn 5 tokens automatically for every 10 minutes of active play.

10 minutes = 5 tokens
1 hour = 30 tokens

Keep exploring, building and taming while your playtime earns rewards. Spend your tokens when you find something you want.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="1,0.851,0,1">USING YOUR TOKENS</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.94,0.96,0.92,1">Open the Reward Shop using the button below. Sign in with the account linked to your survivor to view your balance and purchases.

Earned and purchased tokens use the same shop prices.

Buying tokens is optional:
100 tokens = GBP 1

Examples:
Spino: 900 tokens
TEK Giga: 1,500 tokens

For a balance or purchase issue, contact the team on Discord.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="1,0.851,0,1">CHOOSE YOUR NEXT CREATURE</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.94,0.96,0.92,1">Browse the dinosaur catalogue on our website, then open a listing to see its token price and delivery details.

1. Open Reward Shop below.
2. Sign in and check your token balance.
3. Select your creature and review the listing.
4. Follow the shop checkout and delivery instructions.

There are no dinosaur purchase limits, player-level requirements or progression unlocks.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="1,0.851,0,1">DINOSAUR DELIVERY</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.94,0.96,0.92,1">Shop creatures are delivered inside Pelayori's Cryo Storage cryopods.

Levels are based on the species' obtainable server maximum plus its applicable taming bonus. Special-tame and egg species can differ.

Creatures are supplied breedable where the species supports breeding. Species that cannot naturally breed remain exceptions.

There is no shop restriction requiring delivery on a particular map.

Keep your purchase details if you need help with delivery.</>

Special species use their own level ranges.</>

content.text:

EGG HATCHING
20x hatch speed

MATING INTERVAL
0.1x the standard interval

CUDDLE INTERVAL

IMPRINT AMOUNT
5x imprint amount multiplier

These are server-wide settings, shown here for reference.</>
